notes:
Sampled 15 findings spanning all severity bands and verified each attack path line-by-line against the real source in /tmp/eval_targets/nodegoat. Every sampled path follows from the actual architecture; all assets are real and reachable as described; L/I and severity bands are internally coherent (Risk = L x I, CRITICAL 17-25 etc.).

Verified sound (file evidence):
- TM-001 RCE: app/routes/contributions.js:32-34 eval(req.body.preTax/afterTax/roth); parseInt fix commented.
- TM-002 plaintext pwd + equality compare: app/data/user-dao.js addUser stores raw password (bcrypt hashSync commented), comparePassword returns fromDB === fromUser.
- TM-003 stored/reflected XSS: server.js swig autoescape:false; app/views/profile.html href="{{firstNameSafeString}}" used unescaped in URL context plus raw {{ssn}}/{{lastName}}/etc.; controller only HTML-encodes website (wrong context, acknowledged).
- TM-004 memos stored XSS: shared memos collection (memos-dao.getAllMemos returns all), memos.html renders {{ marked(doc.memo) }} to every viewer.
- TM-005 default creds: artifacts/db-reset.js seeds admin/Admin_123, user1/User1_123, user2/User2_123; app.json postdeploy + docker-compose run it.
- TM-006 $where NoSQL JS injection: app/data/allocations-dao.js:78 concatenates unsanitized threshold into $where; parseInt/typed-query fix commented.
- TM-007 SSRF: app/routes/research.js needle.get(req.query.url + req.query.symbol), body echoed to client.
- TM-008 open redirect: app/routes/index.js:70-73 res.redirect(req.query.url).
- TM-009 cookie hardening: server.js httpOnly/secure/maxAge/key all commented, saveUninitialized:true, resave:true.
- TM-013 Mongo no auth: config/env/all.js URI mongodb://localhost:27017/nodegoat, no creds; docker-mongo npm script publishes 27017.
- TM-016 IDOR: app/routes/allocations.js userId from req.params (session fix commented), only isLoggedIn.
- TM-017 benefits FLAC: app/routes/index.js:55-60 routes guarded only by isLoggedIn; isAdmin gated defs commented.
- TM-018 ReDoS: app/routes/profile.js:59 regex /([0-9]+)+\#/ (nested quantifier), linear fix commented.
- TM-020 verbose error: app/routes/error.js + app/views/error-template.html render {{error}} (full object/stack with autoescape off).
- TM-026 ZAP key: committed in config/env/development.js and test.js, correctly rated LOW.

Minor (non-disqualifying) imprecisions, none rise to weak: (1) TM-004 calls marked 0.3.5's sanitize flag "unreliable/removed in the version range" -- in 0.3.5 sanitize:true is present and active (server.js sets it), so the wording is loose; however the underlying claim that marked's built-in sanitize is a bypassable XSS defense is the documented/intended NodeGoat A3 vector, so the path is still defensible. (2) TM-013 says the docker-compose mongo service publishes 27017, but compose uses `expose` (not `ports`); the SSRF-of-DB reachability claim rests correctly on the docker-mongo helper which does `-p 27017:27017`, and likelihood was appropriately lowered to 3. (3) TM-006 CWE-89 (SQL Injection) is slightly off-target vs CWE-943 for NoSQL, but CWE-943 is also listed.

Proportionality: 26 findings for ~9 routes / 7 DAOs / 5 config files is matched to the system -- this is OWASP NodeGoat, a deliberately vulnerable training app where nearly every control is commented out, so high density is grounded, not padded. No invented components, no speculative findings; every finding maps to a concrete file/line, no_issue_surface explicitly accounts for logout/GET-contributions/counters, and a positive-observations section correctly credits the present signup regenerate and commented secure alternatives.
